[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Churrhir Fields | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=456 }} [[Churrhir Fields]] is a large training area for the [[Order of the Sunspears]]. The beach here was the landing site of the [[corsair]] raid that was part of the [[Chahbek Village]] [[mission]]. ==Getting there== This area is situated between [[Kamadan]] and [[Chahbek Village (outpost)|Chahbek Village]]. New [[Nightfall]] [[character]]s will brought to the northwestern corner of this location upon completion of the Chahbek Village mission. Characters from other campaigns can easily enter this location by talking to [[Second Spear Binah]] inside Kamadan. The [[secondary quest]] [[Command Training]] leads here and takes place near the center of this location. ==Exits== *[[Chahbek Village (outpost)|Chahbek Village]] (southeast, by talking to [[Historian These were used in the [[Chahbek Village]] mission but they are deactivated here. * Three corpses are placed before [[Ekundayo]] and [[Selah]] for characters to try out the two given [[necromancer]] skills ([[Animate Bone Minions]] and [[Well of Blood]]) that [[Corpse#Exploiting a Corpse|exploit]] [[corpse]]s. Once a corpse is exploited, a new one will spawn nearby. The initial corpses are nameless, but those that spawn are named "Corpse of Istani Peasant". * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.6% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. * This area does not contribute to the Elonian [[Vanquisher]] title track. * Receiving skills from the trainers here will unlock those skills on your account if you did not have them unlocked, but will not teach them to the player unless choosing that secondary in Kamadan, even after changing secondary professions later in the game. == Trivia == * The [[Game_updates/20081009|October 9, 2008 game update]] replaced [[Corsair Prisoner]]s with [[Sunspear Volunteer]]s, [[User_talk:Linsey_Murdock/Questions8#Secret_Update_or_Coincidental_Bug|due to concerns about the use of torture]]. {{Explorable areas in Istan}} [[de:Churrhir-Felder]]
